name: Juice Shop Recon Lab
description: Guided reconnaissance against an exposed OWASP Juice Shop instance from an isolated attacker container.
learning_objectives: Verify network connectivity between the attacker and the target host.
Identify exposed ports and services with a version detection scan.
Validate that the reachable service is a web application worth deeper testing.
Document evidence that supports a basic recon finding.
prerequisites: Understanding of ICMP, TCP ports, and HTTP
Awareness that the lab is for authorized educational use only
success_criteria: The learner confirms target reachability from the attacker container.
The learner identifies that port 3000 is open on the target.
The learner captures evidence that the exposed service is the Juice Shop web application.

tasks.title: Verify connectivity
tasks.objective: Confirm that the attacker container can resolve and reach the target host.
tasks.instruction: Confirm the attacker can reach the target container.
tasks.hint_text: Use the `target` hostname from the attacker shell.
tasks.remediation_text: If ping fails, verify that the lab launched successfully and the target alias is resolvable on the isolated network.
success_criteria: The target responds to ICMP requests from the attacker container.

tasks.title: Identify open services
tasks.objective: Enumerate exposed services and capture evidence of the reachable service.
tasks.instruction: Scan the target to discover open ports and services.
tasks.hint_text: Use version detection so the scan output is useful for reporting.
tasks.remediation_text: If the scan does not show port 3000, confirm the target container is running and wait for the service to finish booting before rescanning.
success_criteria: Port 3000 is identified as open on the target.

tasks.title: Inspect the web application
tasks.objective: Validate that the exposed service is a reachable web application.
tasks.instruction: Fetch the application response from the target.
tasks.hint_text: Capture enough of the response to prove what application is listening on port 3000.
tasks.remediation_text: If curl does not return the app, confirm the service is up and revisit the nmap output before trying again.
success_criteria: The learner captures HTML or HTTP evidence that identifies the Juice Shop app.

tasks.title: Open the application
tasks.objective: Confirm the learner can reach the exposed application in a browser.
tasks.instruction: Open the target in your browser.
expected_evidence: Juice Shop UI loads in the browser
tasks.hint_text: Use the browser URL returned by the lab launcher.
tasks.remediation_text: If the browser does not load, confirm the launcher returned a valid host port and that the target container is still running.
success_criteria: The learner manually confirms that the Juice Shop UI is reachable.
